dataset_title: Green biomass feed nitrogen and dry-matter measurements
citation: Nynäs, A.-L., Newson, W. R., & Johansson, E. (2021). Protein Fractionation of Green Leaves as an Underutilized Food Source—Protein Yield and the Effect of Process Parameters. Foods, 10(11), 2533.
geography: Southern Sweden field residues and Alnarp campus lucerne; retail spinach was Italian produce.
dataset_scope: Table 1 nitrogen content (% of dry matter) and dry matter concentration (% of as-received biomass) for nine green biomasses.

biomass_sources.name: Mangold
biomass_sources.taxon: Beta vulgaris, subsp. vulgaris, var. cicla

biomass_sources.name: Beetroot
biomass_sources.taxon: Beta vulgaris, subsp. vulgaris, var. Red hawk

biomass_sources.name: Sugarbeet
biomass_sources.taxon: Beta vulgaris, subsp. vulgaris, var. Lombok

biomass_sources.name: Lucerne
biomass_sources.context: First-cut crop from Alnarp campus, Sweden

methods: Biomass was rinsed, frozen, and stored at -20 °C. Samples for dry matter and nitrogen analysis were taken before freezing. Nitrogen was determined by Dumas analysis on dried material.
uncertainty: Table 1 reports single values without row-specific standard deviations. No uncertainty was imputed.
conversion_method: None. Nitrogen remains percent of dry matter; dry matter remains percent of as-received sample.
table_specificity_note: Table 1 feed values are retained as a separate source table from Table 2c fraction values. Some biomass nitrogen entries differ between those panels; no averaging or replacement was made.
limitations: The study is not Dutch roadside grass. Lucerne is the closest forage comparator but is not a validated GreenHub feed proxy.
Leafy crop residues, first-cut lucerne, and retail spinach do not represent the full composition range of VARTA roadside grass.
Nitrogen is not crude protein and should not be converted without a justified material-specific factor.
The values do not provide route-level accessible area, annual yield, roadside harvest contamination, or seasonal supply.
This is point-measurement literature evidence; source-level uncertainty and field replication are not reported in this table.
suggested_use: Phase 1 feed-property reference and Phase 4 comparator only. Do not substitute these values for measured roadside-grass feed composition or runtime defaults.
